identity.name: Hunter's Compass
identity.summary: A square brass compass whose needle resembles an arrow.
identity.description: Adds 1 maximum stamina, refreshed each round. Each orthogonally touching ranged gains +2 pierce. Each source applies once per target, regardless of shared edges; distinct sources stack.
identity.lore: The needle points toward the next living threat.

effects.description: Adds 1 maximum stamina, refreshed each round. Each orthogonally touching ranged gains +2 pierce. Each source applies once per target, regardless of shared edges; distinct sources stack.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

empowerment.stacking: once per distinct source and target; different sources add
conditions: Both source and target are equipped.

synergies.description: Orthogonal adjacency support and available mana/stamina determine the best arrangement. Strategic combinations grant no unlisted bonus.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Barbed Tip Roll, Raincatch Bowl into Hunter's Compass.
